title: Billionaire Bill Ackman Sold Hilton Worldwide And Bought This Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock Up 1,650% Since Its IPO
title_zh: 亿万富翁比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 出售希尔顿全球范围并买入这支人工智能 (AI) 股票，自 IPO 以来股价上涨 1,650%
summary: Ackman's most recent AI stock purchase is another great opportunity for investors.
summary_zh: 阿克曼最近购买的人工智能股票对投资者来说是另一个绝佳机会。

title: Chart of the Day 2-16-26- With Past IPOs Slumping, Will Mega-Deals Proceed
title_zh: 每日图表 2-16-26-过去的 IPO 数量大幅下滑，大型交易是否会继续进行
summary: This COULD be the year of the mega-IPO – with top Artificial Intelligence (AI) companies and SpaceX eyeing 2026 public market debuts. But the performance of past Initial Public Offerings is souring, raising questions about investor enthusiasm for big deals.
summary_zh: 今年可能是大型 IPO 之年——顶级人工智能 (AI) 公司和 SpaceX 都计划在 2026 年公开市场首次亮相。但过去首次公开募股的表现正在恶化，引发了人们对投资者对大型交易热情的质疑。

title: U.S. IPO Proceeds Set to Quadruple in 2026? ETFs to Consider
title_zh: 2026 年美国 IPO 收益将翻两番？值得考虑的ETF
summary: As dealmaking momentum builds, the U.S. IPO market may be gearing up for a comeback in 2026. ETFs like FPX, IPO, FPXI and IPOS provide a low-stress way to play the trend.
summary_zh: 随着交易势头增强，美国 IPO 市场可能会在 2026 年卷土重来。FPX、IPO、FPXI 和 IPOS 等 ETF 提供了一种轻松应对这一趋势的方式。

title: Exciting IPO Lineup Ahead? Join the Action With These ETFs
title_zh: 令人兴奋的 IPO 阵容即将到来？与这些 ETF 一起行动
summary: With blockbuster IPOs lining up, ETFs provide a low-stress way to play the trend.
summary_zh: 随着大规模 IPO 的不断涌现，ETF 提供了一种轻松应对趋势的方式。

title: Will 2026 Be a Year for Massive IPOs?
summary: Will 2026 unleash mega IPOs? SpaceX, OpenAI & Anthropic loom large as IPO window reopens. Investors may eye IPO, FPX ETFs for exposure.
summary_zh: 2026 年会出现大型 IPO 吗？随着 IPO 窗口重新开启，SpaceX、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的影响力日益凸显。投资者可能会关注 IPO、FPX ETF 进行投资。
